This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. 

Senior Data Scientist


Experience : 8+ Years

Location : Gurgaon, India

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. About the Role

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Data Scientist to join our dynamic Data Science team at BAXTER India. This strategic role will be instrumental in transforming our business functions through Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning, and data-driven insights.

As a key member of Data Science team, you will leverage cutting-edge data science techniques to optimize financial forecasting, enhance budget planning accuracy, and drive strategic decision-making across the organization. Your work will directly impact BAXTER's financial performance and operational excellence in the healthcare sector.


2. Key Responsibilities

Financial Analytics & Forecasting

•      Develop and maintain advanced predictive models for Sales , revenue forecasting, expense management, and cash flow optimization

•      Build automated  model and reporting systems using AI

•      Design variance analysis frameworks to identify key drivers of financial performance

•      Conduct scenario analysis and sensitivity modeling for strategic initiatives

•      Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership and stakeholders

•      Establish data quality standards and governance frameworks for financial analytics

•      Drive innovation by evaluating and implementing emerging AI/data science technologies

•      Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of data-driven decision making

•      Partner with business leaders to translate complex financial data into actionable insights


3. Qualifications


a) Experience

•      Minimum 8+ years of progressive experience in AI/Data Science.

•      At least 3+ years of hands-on experience in building AI /ML models for Financial Planning & Analysis or Corporate Finance domain.

•      Proven track record of design and delivering production-grade AI/ML projects in enterprise environments for finance.

•      Experience working with large-scale financial datasets and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday).

•      Demonstrated success in cross-functional collaboration with Finance, IT, and Business teams.

•      Hands-on experience in designing and deploying forecasting (Statistical and ML based) applied to financial metrics.

•      Proven experience in designing and deploying production-ready solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs).


b) Core Technical Skills

•      Programming Languages: Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn), SQL (advanced proficiency required).

•      Machine Learning: Regression, Classification, Forecasting, Clustering, Ensemble Methods.

•      Deep Learning: TensorFlow/PyTorch for NLP and predictive modeling applications.

•      Data Visualization: Power BI, Tableau, matplotlib, seaborn, plotly .

•      Agentic AI – Implementation of agentic ai workflow.

•      Cloud platforms :AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI experience.


c) Domain Experience

•      Strong understanding of Finance and FP&A processes:  Forecasting, variance analysis, financial modelling.

•      Knowledge of financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and key metrics.

•      Experience with healthcare/pharmaceutical industry financial operations (preferred).

•      Familiarity with regulatory compliance and data privacy requirements in healthcare industry/ finance.

•      Ability to explain complex ML model outputs to cross functional teams and stakeholders without "black box" ambiguity.

d) Education

•      Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field (required).


4. Nice to Have

•      Experience with healthcare industry-specific challenges with FP&A domain Knowledge .

  • Experience with financial systems (SAP, Oracle, workday, or similar).
  • Hands-on expertise in building autonomous AI agents and implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for seamless data-tool integration.

•      Experience in agile/scrum methodologies and project management.

•      Strong business acumen with ability to translate core technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.


5. What We Offer

Compensation & Benefits

•      Competitive salary package commensurate with experience and market standards

•      Comprehensive health insurance coverage for self and dependents

•      Clear career progression path with regular performance reviews

•      Mentorship from senior leaders and exposure to global projects

Work Environment

•      Collaborative and inclusive culture that values innovation and diversity

•      State-of-the-art workspace in Gurgaon with modern amenities

•      Flexible work arrangements including hybrid work options –3 days in office  arrangement.

Making an Impact

•      Contribute to BAXTER's mission of saving and sustaining lives worldwide

•      Work on meaningful projects that directly improve healthcare outcomes

•      Be part of a Fortune 500 company with global presence and stability

Hear from Our Employees

Our company is enriched by a diverse population of individuals in more than 100 countries that work to solve, innovate, manufacture and drive better healthcare options for patients around the world.

Meet Anchal Tayal, Principal Software Engineer, India

“I am proud to be associated with a company whose mission is to Save and Sustain lives. As a Principal Engineer, my key responsibility is to design and implement the new product features in the most efficient, effective, and maintainable way. These products are designed to empower our patients worldwide. It has been an exciting journey so far full of learnings and a sense of satisfaction in what we do and how it impacts lives.”

Meet Jorge Ramirez, Senior Specialist - Mexico

“Technical skills are really important, but in my case, Baxter helped me in developing soft skills like leadership, work ethic, problem-solving, adaptability, and communication. I’ve learned this by following the example of my manager and some other valuable people. Baxter was the first company that offered me a career plan since the beginning, that was a game changer for me.”

Meet Malgorzata Grzesik, Senior Project Manager, USA

“I feel that everything that I know at work, I learned it from others. We have amazing people from all over the world with different backgrounds, whom I get to work with and learn from every day. I am part of an organization where developing new skills and growing professionally are welcomed and embraced. I have been given many opportunities to grow and take on new challenges. I am also excited and ready for the new ones to come along. With the support of our IT leaders and amazing teammates, we do great things.”

Meet Reagan, Senior Research Scientist in the United States

“For me, the best thing about working at Baxter is being able to do work that’s important to people—especially patients—outside of Baxter's walls. Inside our walls, I get to work with a fantastic team, and we know we're making a difference.”

Meet Karthik, Director of Renal Care R&D - Digital Health & Co-President of the Asian Leadership Network Business Resource Group, United States

“I’m excited about my role because I believe that digital initiatives can make a tremendous impact on lives by allowing people to access the same therapies and have similar care — whether in a hospital, a healthcare clinic, or the patient’s home — anywhere in the world.”

Meet Amitha, Research Associate in India

“Coming from a non-healthcare academic background, my current role has offered ample opportunities to learn a lot of new things. Leaders at Baxter are motivating, help us grow and provide a collaborative environment. The role gives me opportunities to have technical discussions with peers and subject matter experts globally, to learn interacting with customers, and manage project deadlines and deliverables. I am excited about shaping my career here at Baxter.”
